messages.body:
Priya!

Just saw the announcement about the pre-seed. That's huge. I remember you talking about the vet software idea back when we were both stuck in that endless freight optimization meeting, so it's really cool to see it actually happening.

Congrats to you and Dane. Hope it's going well.

Aiden

messages.subject: Re: saw the news
messages.body:
Aiden! Thank you. 

Yes that meeting. Three hours on whether we could shave twelve minutes off a Seattle-to-Portland route by changing which truck stop we used. I think that was the day I started writing the first version of this in a notebook.

How are things at Corvia? Is Theo still making everyone demo on Fridays?

Best,
Priya

messages.subject: Re: saw the news
messages.body:
He is, and they're somehow even longer now. Last week we watched someone present a button redesign for twenty-two minutes.

I'm good though. Still on the routing team, which is fine. Thinking about what's next but not actively doing anything about it yet, you know how that goes.

We should get coffee sometime if you're ever back on this side of the bay. Would love to hear more about what you're building.

A

messages.subject: Re: saw the news
messages.body:
would love that. let me see when things calm down a bit and I'll ping you

Best,
Priya
